short: Bound weighted lattice indices by congruence lengths

lean.name: Formalism.L2.DIV.inEta_num
lean.plain: Bound weighted lattice indices by congruence lengths
lean.note: At each lift level, the sum over the twisted places is at most the full sum of local index terms in the lattice record. The bound on that full sum yields the uniform estimate $C x^\varepsilon(B_0+N_c)$ times the reference rank for the twisted places.
